quotes.text:
/**
   * Signals that the whole operation has finished with the provided status
   * code.
   *
   * If consumers determine that the copy operation cannot or should not be
   * started, they should call this method to ensure the operation is properly
   * dequeued from the global copy service.
   */
  nsresult OnCopyCompleted(nsresult status);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Accepted CopyFileMessage calls handler->OnCopyCompleted when StartCopyingNextMessage fails. The public handler method completes the whole operation and routes listener and dequeue work through the global copy service. Existing corrected knowledge covers that shared queue owner. Keep the startup-failure route when changing this entry point; beginning the operation does not prove that an asynchronous callback will finish a failed start. Other callback-time early returns are separate untested failure routes. This is a scoped manual recommendation from static source. No copy, failure, queue, runtime, build or lint test ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Route Exchange file-copy startup failure through the operation completion owner
